text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
—This year's "Takarazuka Kinen" is 
insanely stacked~!! I'm so hyped! 
...Actually, doesn't it feel like the 
overall level of racing has gone up 
recently?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Ah, definitely. Lately, it feels like all 
the Umamusume are really fired up about 
everything.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
"How do you think today's race will turn 
out? I've got a feeling we might see an 
upset."

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Man, but shouldn't it be Kris S after all? 
She's been in crazy good form lately, and 
her consistency is rock solid, right?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Guess that makes sense~. I kinda want to 
see someone come along and break Kris S's 
dominance, you know~?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...If it's Kris S-san, I'm sure she will 
deliver "results" today as well.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
"...Unlike me, who missed out on the 
'Japanese Derby'...—"

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —Alright.
choice_data_list:
Let's stay sharp and focused, just like 
always.

text_block_list.text:
Today's Takarazuka Kinen boasts an 
exceptionally deep field, to the point 
where it's being hailed as the greatest 
Takarazuka Kinen in history.

With so many skilled competitors, it will 
undoubtedly be a fierce race. The question 
is whether Symboli Kris S can deliver her 
usual powerhouse performance under 
pressure.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: Well then—I'm off.
(WOOOOOOOOH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, seeing her in person really is 
intimidating...! Feels like Kris S might 
sweep it away again—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ohh... So this is the 'Takarazuka 
Kinen'...! Dazzling Umamusume left and 
right, it's so blinding...! Two eyes 
aren't enough...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And! Among them all, with an exceptionally 
unique aura and an overwhelming sense of 
presence, is Kris S-san! As expected, my 
top pick for today—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haua! I am currently basking directly in 
my idol's "sheer presence"! What an 
honor!! I must run in a way worthy of this 
bliss~!!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(A veteran with numerous GⅠ victories, 
Agnes Digital—as expected of her, she 
remains completely unfazed even here.)

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"—This place is 'entropy.' To Neo 
Universe, perhaps it is 'uncontrollable.'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
The 'cause' is... a 'conflict' between 
'SIPT' and 'Providence.' ...We need to 
make an 'observation.'

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(And the Classic Double Crown Umamusume, 
Neo Universe......—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(It's rare to run in the 'Takarazuka 
Kinen' right after the 'Japanese 
Derby'...... There are a lot of unknowns, 
so I need to stay vigilant.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(The other Umamusume are all... formidable 
contenders. However... within me—)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text: —I smell a storm brewing.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them kicking up waves—don't 
you think that makes this a race worth 
catching the wind for?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(...No doubt about it. It's even 
stronger—and hotter—than during the Arima 
Kinen.)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
(And there's likely... still "more" to 
come. We need to stay on guard. But—)

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text:
"...I will—carry out my race. —That is 
all."

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
...You are ever unchanging, unwavering. 
Calm and composed. That is why you are 
strong. But――

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
I'm different. Constantly changing, 
surpassing, and burning bright!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
—Keep your eyes on me! Today, I'll show 
you just how far I can surpass the me of 
the past!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Kris S
text_block_list.text: —I'll take on... your challenge.
